'''Iron Eclipse''' was a [[Computer/Legends|computer]] virus created by [[Iaco Stark/Legends|Iaco]] and [[Iaclyn Stark]], based on Stark's earlier [[navcomputer virus]]. It allowed the Starks to command any [[Droid/Legends|droid]] and it overrode all other programming, including any safety protocols that prevented the droid from injuring [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]]. [[IN-GA 44]] was infected by this virus and ordered to [[Death/Legends|kill]] [[Jahan Cross]] by Iaco Stark.
